answer: Mechanism: identity-bonded stake with slashing. Each agent must lock one scarce bond to act, like a marble that cannot be cheaply duplicated. To run 1,000 sybils an attacker must post 1,000 separate bonds, so cost grows linearly with identities instead of being free. Honest work pays a small positive delta on the bond; provably detected collusion is slashed, burning the deposit like a shattered relic. To break it the attacker must fund thousands of bonds and risk all of them to slashing, so the capital-at-risk makes large sybil fleets unprofitable.
